modules.title: State s_t = [t/T, d_t/(q sqrt t)]
lines: Two features: normalized stage t/T and normalized score gap d_t/(q*sqrt(t)).
Prize/cost params (w_H, w_L, k, q) are NOT in the state (per-cell training).
Player i sees d_t; opponent j sees -d_t (symmetric).
modules.status_note: Two-stage adds stage index t and score gap d_t; drops the parameter features one-stage kept.

plan_divergence.plan_says: s_t = [t/T, d_t/(q sqrt t), w_H, w_L, k, q]

modules.title: Pre-training validity gate (q_crit / SOC)
lines: validate() runs before any training minute; raises if q <= q_crit.
q_crit = max(q_soc, q_bound1, q_bound2, q_pc); q_soc = sqrt(DW/8k) = 41.83.
Analytic screens + numerical global-deviation scan (give-up deviations).
modules.status_note: T9 SOC screen; q=50 passes (q_crit=41.83); q<=40 rejected before training.

plan_divergence.code_does: stage-1 SOC holds only for q>q_soc (kink-corrected curvature)

modules.title: Shared symmetric Beta policy (mean-conc)
lines: One network for both players AND both stages, keyed on (t, d).
mean = sigmoid(head); conc = softplus(head)*scale + conc_min.
alpha = mean*conc, beta = (1-mean)*conc  (NOT softplus+1).
modules.status_note: Mean-conc parameterization (like one-stage's rejected v2 head), so alpha,beta>1 is NOT structurally guaranteed; mode needs a guard.

modules.title: Exploring starts over (t, d)
lines: Each episode resets from a random (t, d) so off-path states get gradient.
rho = es_on_path_fraction = 0.5 start on-path at (t=1, d=0).
Supports the full approximate-MPE claim (best response at ALL states).
modules.status_note: No analogue in one-stage (single fixed state).

modules.title: 2-step MDP: d_{t+1}=d_t+(e_i-e_j)+xi_t
lines: True 2-step episode; done only after stage T (not stitched bandits).
xi_t = eps_i - eps_j sampled as TWO Uniform(-q,q) draws (triangular in law).
y_i,t = e_i,t + eps_i,t; gap accumulates across stages.
modules.status_note: One-stage is a single-shot bandit; two-stage is a genuine dynamic MDP with an accumulating gap.

modules.title: Sampled reward: -k e^2 then terminal prize
lines: Intermediate stages (t<T): r_t = -k e_t^2 (cost only).
Terminal (t=T): winner of ACCUMULATED gap gets w_H, loser w_L, minus k e_T^2.
Closed-form win prob never enters the step reward (sampled-only invariant).
modules.status_note: Sampled-reward invariant shared with one-stage; terminal-only prize + per-stage cost is the two-stage specialization.

modules.title: Vectorized self-play rollout
lines: Batched episodes; each env's two players stored as two separate trajectories.
Both players act from the one shared net (i on d, j on -d).
Trajectory-aware buffer so storage order is irrelevant to GAE.
modules.status_note: Same pure self-play spirit as one-stage, but trajectory-structured for multi-step episodes.

modules.title: GAE, gamma=1, lambda=1 (multi-step)
lines: Trajectory GAE with gamma=1 (finite-horizon economic payoff), lambda=1.
With a genuine 2-step episode the advantage does NOT collapse to r - V.
lambda=1 => Monte-Carlo return advantage A = G - V(s).
modules.status_note: One-stage's single-step bandit collapsed GAE to r-V; two-stage is genuinely multi-step.

modules.title: PPO clipped-surrogate update
lines: Clipped surrogate + value MSE - entropy bonus; advantage normalization.
lr=3e-4, entropy_coef=0.005 (p2cert), clip_eps default, minibatch epochs.
No KL/exploitability early stop inside the update.
modules.status_note: Standard PPO core, same family as one-stage.

modules.title: Fixed-budget training (no early stop)
lines: Training runs a fixed number of PPO updates (p2cert: 2000).
No KL gate, no exploitability streak, no convergence stop.
Verifier runs every eval-every only to SELECT a checkpoint (see below).
modules.status_note: Structural break from one-stage, whose stop was an exploitability streak (patience 5). Here training is a fixed budget.

modules.title: Best checkpoint by coarse-grid dReach
lines: Every eval-every updates, verify on the COARSE grid (51) for selection.
Keep the lowest delta_sum_reachable checkpoint; restore it at the end.
Selection grid (51) is DISJOINT from the certification grids (101/201) [D5].
modules.status_note: Selects the REPORTED policy, so it is inside the pipeline. D5 fix keeps it off the certifier grid; residual: selection metric is still the same verifier family.

modules.title: Reported effort = Beta mean e_hat_t(d)
lines: e_hat_t(d) = e_min + (e_max-e_min) * alpha/(alpha+beta): a CURVE over d.
Mean is the reported extraction and the object handed to the verifier.
Probed at d in {-2q,-q,0,q,2q}; stage-1 reported at d=0.
modules.status_note: Beta-mean extraction inherited from one-stage; two-stage reports a full curve over d instead of a scalar.

modules.title: On-path E[e_hat_2(d_2)] by quadrature
lines: E[e_hat_2(d_2)] = integral e_hat_2(delta) f_xi(delta) ddelta (Gauss-Legendre).
On-path d_2 = xi_1 ~ Triangular(-2q,2q); target = g1 = 46.6667 (NOT 70).
This is the D1 quantity previously omitted from the T=2 report.
modules.status_note: D1 fix; deterministic quadrature, exact on affine effort segments.

modules.title: Mode extraction (diagnostic only)
lines: mode_norm = (alpha-1)/(alpha+beta-2) when alpha>1 AND beta>1, else mean.
Reported alongside mean; MEAN stays primary (repo invariant).
Measured mean-minus-mode E[e2] = 0.074 (negligible).
modules.status_note: D6 fix; mode is a diagnostic column, not the reported number.

modules.title: No post-training effort polish
lines: There is NO MC-BR polish (or any post-training solver) in the two-stage path.
One-stage's external utils/mc_br_polish.py has no two-stage analogue.
Reported effort is the raw PPO Beta-mean curve; draw no polish box.
modules.status_note: ABSENCE marker (verified: no polish/mc_br reference in any two-stage module). Boundary is clean: the reported number is raw PPO, certified in place.

modules.title: Independent DP backward-induction verifier
lines: Backward induction over a score-gap grid; best response by effort-grid argmax.
One-step deviation gap Delta_t(d) against the LEARNED continuation.
D_max = T(e_bar+2q)+50; e-grid 201; parabolic sub-grid argmax refinement.
modules.status_note: Independent of PPO; does not modify the effort. This is the certification, not a polish.

modules.title: Deterministic triangular quadrature
lines: Continuation E_xi via n_quad=129 nodes weighted by f_xi on [-2q,2q].
No Monte Carlo anywhere in the verify/cert path.
Smoothed continuation = sum w * interp(landing + xi).
modules.status_note: D2/D3 spec's deterministic quadrature (the retired MC/1.96/EXP^UCB rule is absent).

modules.title: Closed-form terminal integration
lines: terminal_W(y) = w_L + DW * F_xi(y), exact (never interpolates step reward R).
F_xi is the triangular CDF of xi = eps_i - eps_j.
Matches the closed-form ground truth at the terminal step.
modules.status_note: Exact terminal integration, no interpolation near the reward discontinuity.

modules.title: BR-reachable support R_t
lines: Forward-propagate unit mass at d=0 through the BR drift to get mu^BR_t(d).
dReach = sum_t max over cells with mass>1e-9 of Delta_t(d).
delta_sum_full (full-grid max) is a SEPARATE robustness diagnostic.
modules.status_note: R_t is genuinely computed (not a full-grid max in disguise); the full-grid max is reported separately as delta_sum_full.

modules.title: dReach_UCB gate: dReach_UCB/DW <= 0.03
lines: dReach_UCB = dReach_fine + |dReach_fine - dReach_coarse| (coarse 101, fine 201).
Deterministic discretization margin (NOT a Monte-Carlo CI).
Certify iff dReach_UCB/DW <= 0.03; >= 4/5 seeds required for the gate.
modules.status_note: D3 fix. exp_ucb is also formed but is a reported diagnostic, not the gate.

plan_divergence.code_does: dReach_UCB = dReach_fine + |fine-coarse|, deterministic; EXP^UCB kept only as a reported diagnostic

modules.title: CF-vs-verifier calibration (error floor)
lines: Checks EXP(e*_CF) ~ 0 (error floor) and EXP(bad policy) >> EXP(e*_CF).
Confirms dReach >= EXP (true upper bound) and Richardson consistency.
CF policy certifies (UCB/DW << 0.03); constant-high policy fails.
modules.status_note: Calibration implemented and passing; standalone artifact is the F2 calibration figure. No committed calibration JSON.
